            nn.Linear(hist_dim, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.spec_encoder = timm.create_model(
            "efficientnet_b0", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        for name, param in self.spec_encoder.named_parameters():
            if (
                "blocks.6" in name
                or "blocks.7" in name
                or "blocks.8" in name
                or "blocks.9" in name
            ):
                param.requires_grad = True
            else:
                param.requires_grad = False
        self.spec_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1280, spec_out), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(seg_out + 64 + spec_out, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(256, n_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, seg, mask, hist, spec):
        seg_emb = self.seg_transformer(seg, mask)
        hist_emb = self.hist_mlp(hist)
        spec_feat = self.spec_encoder(spec)
        spec_emb = self.spec_proj(spec_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([seg_emb, hist_emb, spec_emb], dim=1)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ---------- Loss functions ----------
def bce_with_label_smoothing(logits, targets, smoothing=0.1):
    n_classes = targets.size(1)
    smoothed_targets = (1 - smoothing) * targets + smoothing / n_classes
    return F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, smoothed_targets)


def kl_divergence(p, q):
    # p, q are probability tensors (B, n_classes) after sigmoid
    # KL(P||Q) = sum p * log(p/q) + (1-p) * log((1-p)/(1-q))
    eps = 1e-8
    p = p.clamp(eps, 1 - eps)
    q = q.clamp(eps, 1 - eps)
    return (
        (p * torch.log(p / q) + (1 - p) * torch.log((1 - p) / (1 - q)))
        .sum(dim=1)
        .mean()
    )


def rdorp_loss(logits1, logits2, targets, lambda_consist=0.5, smoothing=0.1):
    prob1 = torch.sigmoid(logits1)
    prob2 = torch.sigmoid(logits2)
    bce1 = bce_with_label_smoothing(logits1, targets, smoothing)
    bce2 = bce_with_label_smoothing(logits2, targets, smoothing)
    kl = (kl_divergence(prob1, prob2) + kl_divergence(prob2, prob1)) / 2
    return bce1 + bce2 + lambda_consist * kl


# ---------- Validation ----------
def validate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_labels = []
    all_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels, _ in loader:  # _ is dummy
            seg, mask, hist, spec = (
                seg.to(device),
                mask.to(device),
                hist.to(device),
                spec.to(device),
            )
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
            prob = torch.sigmoid(logits)
            prob = torch.nan_to_num(prob, nan=0.5)
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
            all_probs.append(prob.cpu().numpy())
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)
    all_probs = np.concatenate(all_probs, axis=0)
    aucs = [
        roc_auc_score(all_labels[:, i], all_probs[:, i])
        for i in range(n_species)
        if all_labels[:, i].sum() > 0
    ]
    return np.mean(aucs) if aucs else 0.5, all_probs


# ---------- Train fold with R-Drop ----------
def train_fold(train_idx_local, val_idx_local, test_idx_local, device, fold):
    train_ds = BirdRDropDataset(train_idx_local, is_train=True)
    val_ds = BirdRDropDataset(val_idx_local, is_train=False)
    test_ds = BirdRDropDataset(test_idx_local, is_train=False)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, drop_last=True, collate_fn=collate_rdrop
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_standard
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_standard
    )

    model = MultiStreamClassifier().to(device)
    backbone_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "spec_encoder" in n]
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "spec_encoder" not in n]
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(
        [{"params": backbone_params, "lr": 5e-5}, {"params": other_params, "lr": 1e-3}],
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=50)

    best_val_auc = 0.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 10
    no_improve = 0
    max_epochs = 80

    for epoch in range(max_epochs):
        model.train()
        for seg, mask, hist, spec1, spec2, labels in train_loader:
            seg, mask, hist, spec1, spec2 = (
                seg.to(device),
                mask.to(device),
                hist.to(device),
                spec1.to(device),
                spec2.to(device),
            )
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits1 = model(seg, mask, hist, spec1)
            logits2 = model(seg, mask, hist, spec2)
            loss = rdorp_loss(
                logits1, logits2, labels, lambda_consist=0.5, smoothing=0.1
            )
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

        val_auc, _ = validate(model, val_loader, device)
        if val_auc > best_val_auc:
            best_val_auc = val_auc
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1
        if no_improve >= patience:
            break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    _, val_probs = validate(model, val_loader, device)
    _, test_probs = validate(model, test_loader, device)
    return best_val_auc, val_probs, test_probs

        proba_val = np.zeros((X_val.shape[0], n_species))
        proba_test = np.zeros((X_test.shape[0], n_species))
        for i, sp in enumerate(order):
            # features: original + previous predictions
            if i == 0:
                train_feat = X_train
                val_feat = X_val
                test_feat = X_test
            else:
                train_feat = np.hstack([X_train, proba_train[:, order[:i]]])
                val_feat = np.hstack([X_val, proba_val[:, order[:i]]])
                test_feat = np.hstack([X_test, proba_test[:, order[:i]]])
            dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(train_feat, label=y_train[:, sp])
            dval = xgb.DMatrix(val_feat, label=y_val[:, sp])
            param = {
                "objective": "binary:logistic",
                "eval_metric": "auc",
                "max_depth": 4,
                "learning_rate": 0.1,
                "n_jobs": -1,
                "verbosity": 0,
            }
            model = xgb.train(
                param,
                dtrain,
                num_boost_round=200,
                evals=[(dval, "val")],
                early_stopping_rounds=20,
                verbose_eval=False,
            )
            pred_train = model.predict(dtrain)
            pred_val = model.predict(dval)
            pred_test = model.predict(xgb.DMatrix(test_feat))
            proba_train[:, sp] = pred_train
            proba_val[:, sp] = pred_val
            proba_test[:, sp] = pred_test
        # Reorder back to original species order
        inv_order = np.argsort(order)
        chain_preds_val += proba_val[:, inv_order]
        chain_preds_test += proba_test[:, inv_order]
    chain_preds_val /= n_chains
    chain_preds_test /= n_chains
    return chain_preds_val, chain_preds_test

        img = Image.open(fpath).convert("RGB")
        img = transforms.Resize((224, 224))(img)
        spec_raw[i] = transforms.ToTensor()(img).numpy()
    else:
        print(f"WARNING: spectrogram missing for rec_id {rid}", file=sys.stderr)

# Normalization statistics
mean = np.array([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
std = np.array([0.229, 0.224, 0.225], dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)


# ---------- SpecAugment ----------
class SpecAugment:
    def __init__(
        self, max_freq_mask=2, max_time_mask=2, freq_mask_param=12, time_mask_param=12
    ):
        self.max_freq_mask = max_freq_mask
        self.max_time_mask = max_time_mask
        self.F = freq_mask_param
        self.T = time_mask_param

    def __call__(self, spec):
        # spec: (C, H, W) in [0,1]
        _, h, w = spec.shape
        for _ in range(self.max_freq_mask):
            f = random.randint(0, self.F)
            f0 = random.randint(0, h - f)
            spec[:, f0 : f0 + f, :] = 0.0
        for _ in range(self.max_time_mask):
            t = random.randint(0, self.T)
            t0 = random.randint(0, w - t)
            spec[:, :, t0 : t0 + t] = 0.0
        return spec


# ---------- Dataset ----------
class BirdMultiStreamDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, indices, is_train=True, use_tta=False, num_tta=5):
        self.indices = indices
        self.is_train = is_train
        self.use_tta = use_tta
        self.num_tta = num_tta
        self.spec_augment = SpecAugment()

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.indices)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i = self.indices[idx]
        seg = torch.from_numpy(seg_tensor[i])
        mask = torch.from_numpy(seg_mask[i].astype(np.float32))
        hist = torch.from_numpy(hist_tensor[i])
        spec_np = spec_raw[i].copy()  # (3,224,224) in [0,1]
        label = torch.from_numpy(y_full[i])

        if self.is_train:
            if random.random() < 0.5:
                spec_np = self.spec_augment(spec_np)
        # Normalize
        spec = (
            torch.from_numpy(spec_np) - torch.from_numpy(mean[0])
        ) / torch.from_numpy(std[0])
        spec = spec.float()

        if self.use_tta and self.is_train is False:
            # Generate multiple augmented views for TTA
            specs = [spec]
            for _ in range(self.num_tta - 1):
                spec_tta = spec_np.copy()
                if random.random() < 0.5:
                    spec_tta = np.flip(spec_tta, axis=2).copy()
                h, w = 224, 224
                scale = random.uniform(0.9, 1.0)
                new_h = int(h * scale)
                new_w = int(w * scale)
                top = random.randint(0, h - new_h)
                left = random.randint(0, w - new_w)
                spec_tta = spec_tta[:, top : top + new_h, left : left + new_w]
                spec_tta = torch.tensor(spec_tta).float()
                spec_tta = F.interpolate(
                    spec_tta.unsqueeze(0),
                    size=(224, 224),
                    mode="bilinear",
                    align_corners=False,
                ).squeeze(0)
                spec_tta = (spec_tta - torch.from_numpy(mean[0])) / torch.from_numpy(
                    std[0]
                )
                specs.append(spec_tta)
            spec = torch.stack(specs, dim=0)  # (num_tta, 3,224,224)
            return seg, mask, hist, spec, label

        return seg, mask, hist, spec, label


# ---------- mixup collate ----------
def mixup_collate(batch):
    segs, masks, hists, specs, labels = zip(*batch)
    segs = torch.stack(segs, dim=0)
    masks = torch.stack(masks, dim=0)
    hists = torch.stack(hists, dim=0)
    specs = torch.stack(specs, dim=0)
    labels = torch.stack(labels, dim=0)

    alpha = 0.2
    lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    batch_size = segs.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size)
    mixed_specs = lam * specs + (1 - lam) * specs[index]
    mixed_labels = lam * labels + (1 - lam) * labels[index]
    return segs, masks, hists, mixed_specs, mixed_labels, lam


# ---------- Model with Species-Transformer head ----------
class SegmentTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=38, d_model=128, nhead=4, num_layers=2, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Linear(input_dim, d_model)
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, d_model) * 0.02)
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model, nhead=nhead, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.out_dim = d_model

    def forward(self, x, mask):
        # x: (B, L, 38), mask: (B, L) True = padded
        x = self.embed(x)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        key_mask = mask.bool()
        x = self.transformer(x, src_key_padding_mask=key_mask)
        valid = (~mask.bool()).unsqueeze(-1).float()
        x = (x * valid).sum(dim=1) / (valid.sum(dim=1) + 1e-9)
        return x


class SpeciesTransformerHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model=256, nhead=4, num_layers=2, num_species=19, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.query_emb = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(num_species, d_model) * 0.02)
        decoder_layer = nn.TransformerDecoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model, nhead=nhead, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.decoder = nn.TransformerDecoder(decoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.out_linear = nn.Linear(d_model, 1)

    def forward(self, memory):
        # memory: (B, 1, d_model)
        B = memory.size(0)
        queries = self.query_emb.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, 19, d_model)
        tgt = queries
        out = self.decoder(tgt, memory)  # (B, 19, d_model)
        logits = self.out_linear(out).squeeze(-1)  # (B, 19)
        return logits


class MultiStreamClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hist_dim=100, n_classes=19):
        super().__init__()
        self.seg_transformer = SegmentTransformer(
            38, d_model=128, nhead=4, num_layers=2
        )
        self.hist_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hist_dim, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.spec_encoder = timm.create_model(
            "efficientnet_b3", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        for name, param in self.spec_encoder.named_parameters():
            if "blocks.6" in name or "blocks.7" in name or "blocks.8" in name:
                param.requires_grad = True
            else:
                param.requires_grad = False
        self.spec_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(1536, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3))
        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 + 64 + 256, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.species_head = SpeciesTransformerHead(
            d_model=256, nhead=4, num_layers=2, num_species=n_classes
        )

    def forward(self, seg, mask, hist, spec):
        seg_emb = self.seg_transformer(seg, mask)  # (B, 128)
        hist_emb = self.hist_mlp(hist)  # (B, 64)
        spec_feat = self.spec_encoder(spec)  # (B, 1536)
        spec_emb = self.spec_proj(spec_feat)  # (B, 256)
        combined = torch.cat([seg_emb, hist_emb, spec_emb], dim=1)  # (B, 448)
        memory = self.fusion(combined).unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, 256)
        logits = self.species_head(memory)  # (B, 19)
        return logits


# ---------- Label Smoothing BCE ----------
def bce_with_label_smoothing(logits, target, smoothing=0.1):
    target = (1 - smoothing) * target + smoothing / target.size(1)
    return F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, target)


# ---------- Validation ----------
def validate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_labels = []
    all_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels in loader:
            seg, mask, hist, spec = (
                seg.to(device),
                mask.to(device),
                hist.to(device),
                spec.to(device),
            )
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
            prob = torch.sigmoid(logits)
            prob = torch.nan_to_num(prob, nan=0.5)
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
            all_probs.append(prob.cpu().numpy())
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)
    all_probs = np.concatenate(all_probs, axis=0)
    aucs = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        if all_labels[:, i].sum() > 0:
            auc = roc_auc_score(all_labels[:, i], all_probs[:, i])
            if np.isfinite(auc):
                aucs.append(auc)
    return np.mean(aucs) if aucs else 0.5, all_probs


# ---------- Train deep fold ----------
def train_deep_fold(train_idx_local, val_idx_local, test_idx_local, device, fold):
    train_ds = BirdMultiStreamDataset(train_idx_local, is_train=True)
    val_ds = BirdMultiStreamDataset(val_idx_local, is_train=False)
    test_ds = BirdMultiStreamDataset(
        test_idx_local, is_train=False, use_tta=True, num_tta=5
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, collate_fn=mixup_collate, drop_last=True
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_ds, batch_size=8, shuffle=False
    )  # small batch due to TTA

    model = MultiStreamClassifier().to(device)

    backbone_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "spec_encoder" in n]
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "spec_encoder" not in n]

    optimizer = optim.AdamW(
        [{"params": backbone_params, "lr": 1e-5}, {"params": other_params, "lr": 1e-3}],
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )

    scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=50)
    scaler = GradScaler()

    def criterion(logits, targets):
        return bce_with_label_smoothing(logits, targets, smoothing=0.1)

    best_val_auc = 0.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 7
    no_improve = 0
    max_epochs = 80

    for epoch in range(max_epochs):
        model.train()
        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels, lam in train_loader:
            seg, mask, hist, spec, labels = (
                seg.to(device),
                mask.to(device),
                hist.to(device),
                spec.to(device),
                labels.to(device),
            )
            with autocast():
                logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()

        val_auc, _ = validate(model, val_loader, device)
        if val_auc > best_val_auc:
            best_val_auc = val_auc
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1
        if no_improve >= patience:
            break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    _, val_probs = validate(model, val_loader, device)
    # Test predictions with TTA
    model.eval()
    test_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for seg, mask, hist, spec_batch, _ in test_loader:
            B, num_tta, C, H, W = spec_batch.shape
            seg = seg.to(device)
            mask = mask.to(device)
            hist = hist.to(device)
            prob_sum = torch.zeros(B, n_species).to(device)
            for t in range(num_tta):
                spec = spec_batch[:, t, :, :, :].to(device)
                with autocast():
                    logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
                    prob = torch.sigmoid(logits)
                prob = torch.nan_to_num(prob, nan=0.5)
                prob_sum += prob
            prob_avg = prob_sum / num_tta
            test_probs_list.append(prob_avg.cpu().numpy())
    test_probs = np.concatenate(test_probs_list, axis=0)
    return best_val_auc, val_probs, test_probs


# ---------- XGBoost Classifier Chain ----------
def train_xgb_chain(train_idx_local, val_idx_local, test_idx_local, seed):
    X_train = tab_feats[train_idx_local]

    val_preds = np.zeros_like(y_val, dtype=np.float32)
    test_preds = np.zeros((len(test_idx_local), n_species), dtype=np.float32)
    current_feats_train = X_train.copy()
    current_feats_val = X_val.copy()
    current_feats_test = X_test.copy()

    for sp in species_order:
        # FIX: move early_stopping_rounds to constructor
        model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
            n_estimators=200,
            max_depth=4,
            learning_rate=0.1,
            subsample=0.8,
            colsample_bytree=0.8,
            random_state=seed,
            verbosity=0,
            use_label_encoder=False,
            eval_metric="logloss",
            early_stopping_rounds=20,  # ADDED HERE
        )
        model.fit(
            current_feats_train,

        val_preds[:, sp] = val_prob
        test_preds[:, sp] = test_prob
        # Append predictions as new features for next species
        current_feats_train = np.hstack([current_feats_train, y_train[:, sp : sp + 1]])
        current_feats_val = np.hstack([current_feats_val, val_prob.reshape(-1, 1)])
        current_feats_test = np.hstack([current_feats_test, test_prob.reshape(-1, 1)])

    return val_preds, test_preds

label_counts = y_full[train_idx].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
bins = np.digitize(label_counts, bins=[0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 10])

deep_oof = np.zeros((len(train_idx), n_species), dtype=np.float32)

fold_aucs_deep = []

for fold, (train_part, val_part) in enumerate(skf.split(train_idx, bins)):

def load_labels(path):
    labels = {}

    for line in lines[start:]:

        rid = int(parts[0])

        )

        )

# ---------- safe macro AUC ----------
def safe_macro_auc(y_true, y_pred):
    """Compute macro AUC across species, defaulting to 0.5 for species with insufficient class variation."""
    n_species = y_true.shape[1]
    aucs = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        if y_true[:, i].sum() > 0 and y_true[:, i].sum() < y_true.shape[0]:
            try:
                auc = roc_auc_score(y_true[:, i], y_pred[:, i])
                if np.isfinite(auc):
                    aucs.append(auc)
                else:
                    aucs.append(0.5)
            except:
                aucs.append(0.5)
        else:
            aucs.append(0.5)
    return np.mean(aucs)

seg_dim = 38

for i, rid in enumerate(all_rec_ids):

def compute_rect_stats(rects_list):
    if not rects_list:
        return np.zeros(12, dtype=np.float32)
    rects = np.array(rects_list)  # (num_rects, 4)
    widths = rects[:, 1] - rects[:, 0]
    heights = rects[:, 3] - rects[:, 2]
    areas = widths * heights
    stats = np.concatenate(
        [
            [np.mean(areas), np.std(areas), np.max(areas), np.sum(areas)],
            [np.mean(widths), np.std(widths), np.max(widths), np.sum(widths)],
            [np.mean(heights), np.std(heights), np.max(heights), np.sum(heights)],
        ]
    )
    stats = np.nan_to_num(stats, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    return stats.astype(np.float32)


# ---------- compute aggregated tabular features for XGBoost ----------
tab_feat_dim = (
    100 + 152 + 12
)  # histogram(100) + segment stats(152) + rect stats(12) = 264
tab_feats = np.zeros((len(all_rec_ids), tab_feat_dim), dtype=np.float32)
for i, rid in enumerate(all_rec_ids):
    h = histogram.get(rid)
    if h is None:
        h = np.zeros(100, dtype=np.float32)
    seg_list = segment_features.get(rid, [])

        seg_min = seg_arr.min(axis=0)
        seg_stats = np.concatenate([seg_mean, seg_std, seg_max, seg_min])
    else:
        seg_stats = np.zeros(152, dtype=np.float32)
    rects = segment_rectangles.get(rid, [])
    rect_stats = compute_rect_stats(rects)
    feats = np.concatenate([h, seg_stats, rect_stats])

mean = np.array([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
std = np.array([0.229, 0.224, 0.225], dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)


# ---------- SpecAugment ----------
class SpecAugment:
    def __init__(
        self, max_freq_mask=2, max_time_mask=2, freq_mask_param=12, time_mask_param=12
    ):
        self.max_freq_mask = max_freq_mask
        self.max_time_mask = max_time_mask
        self.F = freq_mask_param
        self.T = time_mask_param

    def __call__(self, spec):
        _, h, w = spec.shape
        for _ in range(self.max_freq_mask):
            f = random.randint(0, self.F)
            f0 = random.randint(0, h - f)
            spec[:, f0 : f0 + f, :] = 0.0
        for _ in range(self.max_time_mask):
            t = random.randint(0, self.T)
            t0 = random.randint(0, w - t)
            spec[:, :, t0 : t0 + t] = 0.0
        return spec


# ---------- Dataset ----------
class BirdMultiStreamDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, indices, is_train=True, use_tta=False, num_tta=5):
        self.indices = indices
        self.is_train = is_train
        self.use_tta = use_tta
        self.num_tta = num_tta
        self.spec_augment = SpecAugment()

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.indices)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i = self.indices[idx]
        seg = torch.from_numpy(seg_tensor[i])
        mask = torch.from_numpy(seg_mask[i].astype(np.float32))
        hist = torch.from_numpy(hist_tensor[i])
        spec_np = spec_raw[i].copy()
        label = torch.from_numpy(y_full[i])

        if self.is_train:
            if random.random() < 0.5:
                spec_np = self.spec_augment(spec_np)

        spec = (
            torch.from_numpy(spec_np) - torch.from_numpy(mean[0])
        ) / torch.from_numpy(std[0])
        spec = spec.float()

        if self.use_tta and self.is_train is False:
            specs = [spec]
            for _ in range(self.num_tta - 1):
                spec_tta = spec_np.copy()
                if random.random() < 0.5:
                    spec_tta = np.flip(spec_tta, axis=2).copy()
                h, w = 224, 224
                scale = random.uniform(0.9, 1.0)
                new_h = int(h * scale)
                new_w = int(w * scale)
                top = random.randint(0, h - new_h)
                left = random.randint(0, w - new_w)
                spec_tta = spec_tta[:, top : top + new_h, left : left + new_w]
                spec_tta = torch.tensor(spec_tta).float()
                spec_tta = F.interpolate(
                    spec_tta.unsqueeze(0),
                    size=(224, 224),
                    mode="bilinear",
                    align_corners=False,
                ).squeeze(0)
                spec_tta = (spec_tta - torch.from_numpy(mean[0])) / torch.from_numpy(
                    std[0]
                )
                specs.append(spec_tta)
            spec = torch.stack(specs, dim=0)
            return seg, mask, hist, spec, label

        return seg, mask, hist, spec, label


# ---------- mixup collate ----------
def mixup_collate(batch):
    segs, masks, hists, specs, labels = zip(*batch)
    segs = torch.stack(segs, dim=0)
    masks = torch.stack(masks, dim=0)
    hists = torch.stack(hists, dim=0)
    specs = torch.stack(specs, dim=0)
    labels = torch.stack(labels, dim=0)

    alpha = 0.2
    lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    batch_size = segs.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size)
    mixed_specs = lam * specs + (1 - lam) * specs[index]
    mixed_labels = lam * labels + (1 - lam) * labels[index]
    return segs, masks, hists, mixed_specs, mixed_labels, lam


# ---------- Model with Species-Transformer head ----------
class SegmentTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=38, d_model=128, nhead=4, num_layers=2, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Linear(input_dim, d_model)
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, d_model) * 0.02)
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model, nhead=nhead, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.out_dim = d_model

    def forward(self, x, mask):
        x = self.embed(x)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        key_mask = mask.bool()
        x = self.transformer(x, src_key_padding_mask=key_mask)
        valid = (~mask.bool()).unsqueeze(-1).float()
        x = (x * valid).sum(dim=1) / (valid.sum(dim=1) + 1e-9)
        return x


class SpeciesTransformerHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model=256, nhead=4, num_layers=2, num_species=19, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.query_emb = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(num_species, d_model) * 0.02)
        decoder_layer = nn.TransformerDecoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model, nhead=nhead, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.decoder = nn.TransformerDecoder(decoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.out_linear = nn.Linear(d_model, 1)

    def forward(self, memory):
        B = memory.size(0)
        queries = self.query_emb.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)
        tgt = queries
        out = self.decoder(tgt, memory)
        logits = self.out_linear(out).squeeze(-1)
        return logits


class MultiStreamClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hist_dim=100, n_classes=19):
        super().__init__()
        self.seg_transformer = SegmentTransformer(
            38, d_model=128, nhead=4, num_layers=2
        )
        self.hist_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hist_dim, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.spec_encoder = timm.create_model(
            "efficientnet_b3", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        for name, param in self.spec_encoder.named_parameters():
            if "blocks.6" in name or "blocks.7" in name or "blocks.8" in name:
                param.requires_grad = True
            else:
                param.requires_grad = False
        self.spec_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(1536, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3))
        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 + 64 + 256, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.species_head = SpeciesTransformerHead(
            d_model=256, nhead=4, num_layers=2, num_species=n_classes
        )

    def forward(self, seg, mask, hist, spec):
        seg_emb = self.seg_transformer(seg, mask)
        hist_emb = self.hist_mlp(hist)
        spec_feat = self.spec_encoder(spec)
        spec_emb = self.spec_proj(spec_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([seg_emb, hist_emb, spec_emb], dim=1)
        memory = self.fusion(combined).unsqueeze(1)
        logits = self.species_head(memory)
        return logits


# ---------- Label Smoothing BCE ----------
def bce_with_label_smoothing(logits, target, smoothing=0.1):
    target = (1 - smoothing) * target + smoothing / target.size(1)
    return F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, target)


# ---------- Validation ----------
def validate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_labels = []
    all_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels in loader:
            seg, mask, hist, spec = (
                seg.to(device),
                mask.to(device),
                hist.to(device),
                spec.to(device),
            )
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
            prob = torch.sigmoid(logits)
            prob = torch.nan_to_num(prob, nan=0.5)
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
            all_probs.append(prob.cpu().numpy())
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)
    all_probs = np.concatenate(all_probs, axis=0)
    return safe_macro_auc(all_labels, all_probs), all_probs


# ---------- Train deep fold ----------
def train_deep_fold(train_idx_local, val_idx_local, test_idx_local, device, fold):
    train_ds = BirdMultiStreamDataset(train_idx_local, is_train=True)
    val_ds = BirdMultiStreamDataset(val_idx_local, is_train=False)
    test_ds = BirdMultiStreamDataset(
        test_idx_local, is_train=False, use_tta=True, num_tta=5
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, collate_fn=mixup_collate, drop_last=True
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=8, shuffle=False)

    model = MultiStreamClassifier().to(device)

    backbone_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "spec_encoder" in n]
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "spec_encoder" not in n]

    optimizer = optim.AdamW(
        [{"params": backbone_params, "lr": 1e-5}, {"params": other_params, "lr": 1e-3}],
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )

    scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=50)
    scaler = GradScaler()

    def criterion(logits, targets):
        return bce_with_label_smoothing(logits, targets, smoothing=0.1)

    best_val_auc = 0.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 7
    no_improve = 0
    max_epochs = 80

    for epoch in range(max_epochs):
        model.train()
        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels, lam in train_loader:
            seg, mask, hist, spec, labels = (
                seg.to(device),
                mask.to(device),
                hist.to(device),
                spec.to(device),
                labels.to(device),
            )
            with autocast():
                logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()

        val_auc, _ = validate(model, val_loader, device)
        if val_auc > best_val_auc:
            best_val_auc = val_auc
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1
        if no_improve >= patience:
            break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    _, val_probs = validate(model, val_loader, device)

    # Test predictions with TTA
    model.eval()
    test_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for seg, mask, hist, spec_batch, _ in test_loader:
            B, num_tta, C, H, W = spec_batch.shape
            seg = seg.to(device)
            mask = mask.to(device)
            hist = hist.to(device)
            prob_sum = torch.zeros(B, n_species).to(device)
            for t in range(num_tta):
                spec = spec_batch[:, t, :, :, :].to(device)
                with autocast():
                    logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
                    prob = torch.sigmoid(logits)
                prob = torch.nan_to_num(prob, nan=0.5)
                prob_sum += prob
            prob_avg = prob_sum / num_tta
            test_probs_list.append(prob_avg.cpu().numpy())
    test_probs = np.concatenate(test_probs_list, axis=0)
    return best_val_auc, val_probs, test_probs


# ---------- XGBoost Classifier Chain ----------
def train_xgb_chain(train_idx_local, val_idx_local, test_idx_local, seed):
    X_train = tab_feats[train_idx_local]
    y_train = y_full[train_idx_local]
    X_val = tab_feats[val_idx_local]
    y_val = y_full[val_idx_local]
    X_test = tab_feats[test_idx_local]

    species_order = np.random.RandomState(seed).permutation(n_species).tolist()
    val_preds = np.zeros_like(y_val, dtype=np.float32)
    test_preds = np.zeros((len(test_idx_local), n_species), dtype=np.float32)
    current_feats_train = X_train.copy()
    current_feats_val = X_val.copy()
    current_feats_test = X_test.copy()

    for sp in species_order:
        model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
            n_estimators=200,
            max_depth=4,
            learning_rate=0.1,
            subsample=0.8,
            colsample_bytree=0.8,
            random_state=seed,
            verbosity=0,
            use_label_encoder=False,
            eval_metric="logloss",
            early_stopping_rounds=20,
        )
        model.fit(
            current_feats_train,
            y_train[:, sp],
            eval_set=[(current_feats_val, y_val[:, sp])],
            verbose=False,
        )
        val_prob = model.predict_proba(current_feats_val)[:, 1]
        test_prob = model.predict_proba(current_feats_test)[:, 1]
        val_preds[:, sp] = val_prob
        test_preds[:, sp] = test_prob
        current_feats_train = np.hstack([current_feats_train, y_train[:, sp : sp + 1]])
        current_feats_val = np.hstack([current_feats_val, val_prob.reshape(-1, 1)])
        current_feats_test = np.hstack([current_feats_test, test_prob.reshape(-1, 1)])

    return val_preds, test_preds


# ---------- 5-Fold Cross-Validation ----------
label_counts = y_full[train_idx].sum(axis=1).astype(int)
bins = np.digitize(label_counts, bins=[0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 10])

fold_aucs_deep = []

for fold, (train_part, val_part) in enumerate(skf.split(train_idx, bins)):

# Final ensemble test predictions
final_test_probs = (deep_test + xgb_test) / 2.0

# Build submission
sub_rows = []
for idx_in_test, rid in enumerate(test_ids):

# ---------- helper functions ----------
def load_labels(path):
    labels = {}
    with open(path) as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    start = 1 if not lines[0].split(",")[0].isdigit() else 0
    for line in lines[start:]:
        parts = line.strip().split(",")
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        rid = int(parts[0])
        labels[rid] = (
            None if parts[1] == "?" else [int(x) for x in parts[1:] if x.strip()]
        )
    return labels

    folds = {}

    start = 1 if not lines[0].split(",")[0].isdigit() else 0
    for line in lines[start:]:
        parts = line.strip().split(",")
        if len(parts) != 2:

        folds[int(parts[0])] = int(parts[1])
    return folds

# ---------- EMA helper ----------
class EMA:
    def __init__(self, model, decay=0.999):
        self.model = model
        self.decay = decay
        self.shadow = {}
        self.backup = {}
        self.register()

    def register(self):
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if param.requires_grad:
                self.shadow[name] = param.data.clone()

    def update(self):
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if param.requires_grad:
                new_average = (
                    1.0 - self.decay
                ) * param.data + self.decay * self.shadow[name]
                self.shadow[name] = new_average.clone()

    def apply_shadow(self):
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if param.requires_grad:
                self.backup[name] = param.data.clone()
                param.data = self.shadow[name]

    def restore(self):
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if param.requires_grad:
                param.data = self.backup[name]
        self.backup = {}

# ---------- Dataset ----------
class BirdDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, indices, spec_augment=False, spec_aug_prob=0.5):
        self.indices = indices
        self.spec_augment = spec_augment
        self.spec_aug_prob = spec_aug_prob
        self.n_freq_masks = 2
        self.n_time_masks = 2
        self.freq_mask_width = 10
        self.time_mask_width = 10
        self.hflip = transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.indices)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i = self.indices[idx]
        seg = torch.from_numpy(seg_tensor[i])
        mask = torch.from_numpy(seg_mask[i].astype(bool))
        hist = torch.from_numpy(hist_tensor[i])
        tab = torch.from_numpy(tabular_tensor[i])
        spec = torch.from_numpy(spec_tensor[i])
        if self.spec_augment and np.random.rand() < self.spec_aug_prob:
            spec = self.apply_spec_augment(spec)
            spec = self.hflip(spec)
        label = torch.from_numpy(y_full[i])
        return seg, mask, hist, tab, spec, label

    def apply_spec_augment(self, spec):
        _, h, w = spec.shape
        # frequency masking
        for _ in range(self.n_freq_masks):
            f = np.random.randint(0, self.freq_mask_width)
            f_start = np.random.randint(0, h - f)
            spec[:, f_start : f_start + f, :] = 0.0
        # time masking
        for _ in range(self.n_time_masks):
            t = np.random.randint(0, self.time_mask_width)
            t_start = np.random.randint(0, w - t)
            spec[:, :, t_start : t_start + t] = 0.0
        return spec


def collate_mixup(batch, alpha=0.2):
    segs, masks, hists, tabs, specs, labels = zip(*batch)
    segs = torch.stack(segs, dim=0)
    masks = torch.stack(masks, dim=0)
    hists = torch.stack(hists, dim=0)
    tabs = torch.stack(tabs, dim=0)
    specs = torch.stack(specs, dim=0)
    labels = torch.stack(labels, dim=0)
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
        idx = torch.randperm(len(segs))
        segs = lam * segs + (1 - lam) * segs[idx]
        specs = lam * specs + (1 - lam) * specs[idx]
        labels = lam * labels + (1 - lam) * labels[idx]
    return segs, masks, hists, tabs, specs, labels


# ---------- Model components ----------
class SegmentTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model=128, nhead=4, num_layers=2, dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Linear(38, d_model)
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model,
            nhead,
            dim_feedforward=d_model * 4,
            dropout=dropout,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, seg, mask):
        # seg: (batch, max_seg, 38), mask: (batch, max_seg) True = padded
        x = self.input_proj(seg)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.transformer(x, src_key_padding_mask=mask)
        valid = (~mask).float().unsqueeze(-1)
        pooled = (x * valid).sum(dim=1) / (valid.sum(dim=1) + 1e-8)
        return pooled


class HistogramMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_out=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(100, d_out), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class TabularMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim=12, d_out=32):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(dim, d_out), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class MultiStreamClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_seg=128, d_hist=64, d_tab=32, d_spec=256, n_classes=19):
        super().__init__()
        self.segment_encoder = SegmentTransformer(d_model=d_seg)
        self.hist_encoder = HistogramMLP(d_out=d_hist)
        self.tab_encoder = TabularMLP(dim=12, d_out=d_tab)
        self.spec_encoder = timm.create_model(
            "convnext_tiny", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        # freeze all spec_encoder parameters, then unfreeze last two blocks
        for param in self.spec_encoder.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # gather all blocks across stages
        all_blocks = []
        for stage in self.spec_encoder.stages:
            for block in stage.blocks:
                all_blocks.append(block)
        # unfreeze last two blocks
        for block in all_blocks[-2:]:
            for param in block.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.spec_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, d_spec), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        fusion_in = d_seg + d_hist + d_tab + d_spec
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(fusion_in, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(256, n_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, seg, mask, hist, tab, spec):
        seg_emb = self.segment_encoder(seg, mask)
        hist_emb = self.hist_encoder(hist)
        tab_emb = self.tab_encoder(tab)
        spec_feat = self.spec_encoder(spec)
        spec_emb = self.spec_proj(spec_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([seg_emb, hist_emb, tab_emb, spec_emb], dim=1)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ---------- Label smoothing loss ----------
class LabelSmoothingBCEWithLogitsLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        smoothed = targets * (1 - self.smoothing) + (1 - targets) * (
            self.smoothing / (n_species - 1)
        )
        return F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, smoothed)


# ---------- Validation function ----------
def validate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_labels = []
    all_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for seg, mask, hist, tab, spec, labels in loader:
            seg = seg.to(device)
            mask = mask.to(device)
            hist = hist.to(device)
            tab = tab.to(device)
            spec = spec.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits = model(seg, mask, hist, tab, spec)
            prob = torch.sigmoid(logits)
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
            all_probs.append(prob.cpu().numpy())
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)
    all_probs = np.concatenate(all_probs, axis=0)
    aucs = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        if all_labels[:, i].sum() > 0 and np.unique(all_labels[:, i]).size > 1:
            aucs.append(roc_auc_score(all_labels[:, i], all_probs[:, i]))
    return np.mean(aucs) if aucs else 0.5, all_probs


# ---------- Training function for deep model ----------
def train_fold_deep(train_sub_idx, val_sub_idx, test_idx, device, seed):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    random.seed(seed)

    train_ds = BirdDataset(train_sub_idx, spec_augment=True)
    val_ds = BirdDataset(val_sub_idx, spec_augment=False)
    test_ds = BirdDataset(test_idx, spec_augment=False)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds,
        batch_size=16,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=lambda b: collate_mixup(b, alpha=0.2),
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=False)

    model = MultiStreamClassifier().to(device)
    ema = EMA(model, decay=0.999)

    backbone_params = [
        p
        for n, p in model.named_parameters()
        if "spec_encoder" in n and p.requires_grad
    ]
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "spec_encoder" not in n]

    optimizer = optim.AdamW(
        [{"params": backbone_params, "lr": 1e-5}, {"params": other_params, "lr": 1e-3}],
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=20, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-6)
    criterion = LabelSmoothingBCEWithLogitsLoss(smoothing=0.1)

    best_val_auc = 0.0
    best_ema_shadow = None  # will store the EMA shadow dict when validation improves
    patience = 7
    no_improve = 0
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler()

    for epoch in range(80):
        model.train()
        for seg, mask, hist, tab, spec, labels in train_loader:
            seg = seg.to(device)
            mask = mask.to(device)
            hist = hist.to(device)
            tab = tab.to(device)
            spec = spec.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                logits = model(seg, mask, hist, tab, spec)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            ema.update()
        scheduler.step()

        # Evaluate with EMA
        ema.apply_shadow()
        val_auc, _ = validate(model, val_loader, device)
        ema.restore()

        if val_auc > best_val_auc:
            best_val_auc = val_auc
            best_ema_shadow = copy.deepcopy(ema.shadow)
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1
        if no_improve >= patience:
            break

    # Load the best EMA shadow for inference
    if best_ema_shadow is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(
            best_ema_shadow, strict=False
        )  # FIX: allow missing keys for frozen layers
    _, val_probs = validate(model, val_loader, device)
    _, test_probs = validate(model, test_loader, device)
    return best_val_auc, val_probs, test_probs

# ---------- XGBoost classifier chains (FIXED) ----------
def train_xgb_chain(train_sub_idx, val_sub_idx, test_idx, seed):
    from xgboost import XGBClassifier

    np.random.seed(seed)
    X_train = tab_all_scaled[train_sub_idx]
    y_train = y_full[train_sub_idx]
    X_val = tab_all_scaled[val_sub_idx]
    y_val = y_full[val_sub_idx]
    X_test = tab_all_scaled[test_idx]

    n_chains = 5
    val_preds = np.zeros_like(y_val)
    test_preds = np.zeros((X_test.shape[0], n_species))
    for chain in range(n_chains):
        order = np.random.permutation(n_species)
        chain_probs_train = np.zeros_like(y_train)  # for training set
        chain_probs_val = np.zeros_like(y_val)
        chain_probs_test = np.zeros((X_test.shape[0], n_species))
        for sp_idx, sp in enumerate(order):
            if sp_idx == 0:
                X_tr = X_train
                X_va = X_val
                X_te = X_test
            else:
                X_tr = np.hstack([X_train, chain_probs_train[:, order[:sp_idx]]])
                X_va = np.hstack([X_val, chain_probs_val[:, order[:sp_idx]]])
                X_te = np.hstack([X_test, chain_probs_test[:, order[:sp_idx]]])

            clf = XGBClassifier(
                n_estimators=200,
                max_depth=4,
                learning_rate=0.1,
                subsample=0.8,
                colsample_bytree=0.8,
                random_state=seed,
                use_label_encoder=False,
                eval_metric="logloss",
                early_stopping_rounds=20,
                verbosity=0,
            )
            clf.fit(
                X_tr, y_train[:, sp], eval_set=[(X_va, y_val[:, sp])], verbose=False
            )
            # Predict on all three sets to update chain probabilities
            chain_probs_train[:, sp] = clf.predict_proba(X_tr)[:, 1]
            chain_probs_val[:, sp] = clf.predict_proba(X_va)[:, 1]
            chain_probs_test[:, sp] = clf.predict_proba(X_te)[:, 1]
        val_preds += chain_probs_val / n_chains
        test_preds += chain_probs_test / n_chains
    # Compute val AUC
    aucs = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        if y_val[:, i].sum() > 0 and np.unique(y_val[:, i]).size > 1:
            aucs.append(roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds[:, i]))
    val_auc = np.mean(aucs) if aucs else 0.5
    return val_auc, val_preds, test_preds

# ---------- Dataset ----------
class BirdDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, indices, spec_augment=False, spec_aug_prob=0.5):
        self.indices = indices
        self.spec_augment = spec_augment
        self.spec_aug_prob = spec_aug_prob
        self.n_freq_masks = 2
        self.n_time_masks = 2
        self.freq_mask_width = 10
        self.time_mask_width = 10

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.indices)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i = self.indices[idx]
        seg = torch.from_numpy(seg_tensor[i])
        mask = torch.from_numpy(seg_mask[i].astype(bool))
        hist = torch.from_numpy(hist_tensor[i])
        spec = torch.from_numpy(spec_tensor[i])
        if self.spec_augment and np.random.rand() < self.spec_aug_prob:
            spec = self.apply_spec_augment(spec)
        label = torch.from_numpy(y_full[i])
        return seg, mask, hist, spec, label

    def apply_spec_augment(self, spec):
        _, h, w = spec.shape
        for _ in range(self.n_freq_masks):
            f = np.random.randint(0, self.freq_mask_width)
            f_start = np.random.randint(0, h - f)
            spec[:, f_start : f_start + f, :] = 0.0
        for _ in range(self.n_time_masks):
            t = np.random.randint(0, self.time_mask_width)
            t_start = np.random.randint(0, w - t)
            spec[:, :, t_start : t_start + t] = 0.0
        return spec


def collate_mixup(batch, alpha=0.2):
    segs, masks, hists, specs, labels = zip(*batch)
    segs = torch.stack(segs, dim=0)
    masks = torch.stack(masks, dim=0)
    hists = torch.stack(hists, dim=0)
    specs = torch.stack(specs, dim=0)
    labels = torch.stack(labels, dim=0)
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
        idx = torch.randperm(len(segs))
        segs = lam * segs + (1 - lam) * segs[idx]
        specs = lam * specs + (1 - lam) * specs[idx]
        labels = lam * labels + (1 - lam) * labels[idx]
    return segs, masks, hists, specs, labels


# ---------- Multi-scale EfficientNet feature extractor ----------
class MultiScaleEfficientNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, backbone_name="efficientnet_b0", pretrained=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            backbone_name,
            pretrained=pretrained,
            features_only=True,
            out_indices=[2, 3, 4],
        )
        # features_only=True returns a list of tensors from selected blocks
        # out_indices indicate which blocks to output (0-indexed: 2,3,4 correspond to blocks after conv2, conv3, conv4)
        # For EfficientNet-B0: feature channel sizes: [24, 40, 112, 320] for indices 1,2,3,4? Let's verify later.
        # We'll compute projection dimension after pooling.
        self.feat_dims = (
            self.backbone.feature_info.channels()
        )  # list of channel dimensions
        # We'll use indices 2,3,4 -> channels [40, 112, 320] for B0
        # After adaptive pooling 7x7: 40*49, 112*49, 320*49
        self.pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((7, 7))
        total_dim = sum(dim * 49 for dim in self.feat_dims)  # total dim after concat
        self.proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(total_dim, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3))

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)  # list of tensors [B, C_i, H_i, W_i]
        pooled = [self.pool(f).view(f.size(0), -1) for f in features]
        concat = torch.cat(pooled, dim=1)
        return self.proj(concat)


# ---------- Model ----------
class SegmentTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model=128, nhead=4, num_layers=2, dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Linear(38, d_model)
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model,
            nhead,
            dim_feedforward=d_model * 4,
            dropout=dropout,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, seg, mask):
        x = self.input_proj(seg)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.transformer(x, src_key_padding_mask=mask)
        valid = (~mask).float().unsqueeze(-1)
        pooled = (x * valid).sum(dim=1) / (valid.sum(dim=1) + 1e-8)
        return pooled


class HistogramMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_out=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(100, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(64, d_out),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class MultiStreamClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model=128, d_hist=64, d_spec=256, n_classes=19):
        super().__init__()
        self.segment_encoder = SegmentTransformer(d_model=d_model)
        self.hist_encoder = HistogramMLP(d_out=d_hist)
        self.spec_encoder = MultiScaleEfficientNet("efficientnet_b0", pretrained=True)
        fusion_in = d_model + d_hist + d_spec
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(fusion_in, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, n_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, seg, mask, hist, spec):
        seg_emb = self.segment_encoder(seg, mask)
        hist_emb = self.hist_encoder(hist)
        spec_emb = self.spec_encoder(spec)
        combined = torch.cat([seg_emb, hist_emb, spec_emb], dim=1)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ---------- Label smoothing loss ----------
class LabelSmoothingBCEWithLogitsLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        smoothed = targets * (1 - self.smoothing) + (1 - targets) * (
            self.smoothing / (n_species - 1)
        )
        return F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, smoothed)


# ---------- Training helpers ----------
def validate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_labels = []
    all_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels in loader:
            seg = seg.to(device)
            mask = mask.to(device)
            hist = hist.to(device)
            spec = spec.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
            prob = torch.sigmoid(logits)
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
            all_probs.append(prob.cpu().numpy())
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)
    all_probs = np.concatenate(all_probs, axis=0)
    aucs = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        if all_labels[:, i].sum() > 0:
            aucs.append(roc_auc_score(all_labels[:, i], all_probs[:, i]))
    return np.mean(aucs) if aucs else 0.5, all_probs


def train_fold(train_idx_local, val_idx_local, test_idx_local, device, seed):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    random.seed(seed)

    train_ds = BirdDataset(train_idx_local, spec_augment=True)
    val_ds = BirdDataset(val_idx_local, spec_augment=False)
    test_ds = BirdDataset(test_idx_local, spec_augment=False)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds,
        batch_size=16,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=lambda b: collate_mixup(b, alpha=0.2),
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=False)

    model = MultiStreamClassifier().to(device)

    backbone_params = [
        p
        for n, p in model.named_parameters()
        if "spec_encoder.backbone" in n and p.requires_grad
    ]
    high_lr_params = [
        p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "spec_encoder.backbone" not in n
    ]

    optimizer = optim.AdamW(
        [
            {"params": backbone_params, "lr": 1e-5},
            {"params": high_lr_params, "lr": 1e-3},
        ],
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )

    scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=50)
    criterion = LabelSmoothingBCEWithLogitsLoss(smoothing=0.1)

    best_val_auc = 0.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 7
    no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(80):
        model.train()
        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels in train_loader:
            seg = seg.to(device)
            mask = mask.to(device)
            hist = hist.to(device)
            spec = spec.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

        val_auc, _ = validate(model, val_loader, device)
        if val_auc > best_val_auc:
            best_val_auc = val_auc
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1
        if no_improve >= patience:
            break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    _, test_probs = validate(model, test_loader, device)
    return best_val_auc, test_probs

def build_tabular_features():
    # histogram (100) + segment features (38 per segment -> mean, std, max, min, count) = 5*38 = 190? Actually simpler: concatenate global statistics: for each rec_id, compute over all segments: mean, std, max, min, count -> 190 dim

            arr = np.stack(feats)
            seg_feats_all[i, :38] = arr.mean(axis=0)
            seg_feats_all[i, 38 : 2 * 38] = arr.std(axis=0)
            seg_feats_all[i, 2 * 38 : 3 * 38] = arr.max(axis=0)
            seg_feats_all[i, 3 * 38 : 4 * 38] = arr.min(axis=0)
            seg_feats_all[i, 4 * 38 : 5 * 38] = len(feats)
    # rectangle statistics
    rect_feats_all = np.zeros((n_rec, 15), dtype=np.float32)
    rect_path = os.path.join(supp_dir, "segment_rectangles.txt")
    rects = {}
    with open(rect_path) as f:

    start = 1 if not lines[0].split(",")[0].isdigit() else 0
    for line in lines[start:]:
        parts = line.strip().split(",")
        if len(parts) < 6:
            continue
        rid = int(parts[0])
        xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax = map(float, parts[2:6])
        area = (xmax - xmin) * (ymax - ymin)
        width = xmax - xmin
        height = ymax - ymin
        rects.setdefault(rid, []).append([area, width, height])
    for i, rid in enumerate(rec_ids):
        rlist = rects.get(rid, [])
        if len(rlist) > 0:
            arr = np.array(rlist)
            rect_feats_all[i, 0] = arr[:, 0].mean()
            rect_feats_all[i, 1] = arr[:, 0].std()
            rect_feats_all[i, 2] = arr[:, 0].max()
            rect_feats_all[i, 3] = arr[:, 0].min()
            rect_feats_all[i, 4] = len(rlist)
            rect_feats_all[i, 5] = arr[:, 1].mean()
            rect_feats_all[i, 6] = arr[:, 1].std()
            rect_feats_all[i, 7] = arr[:, 1].max()
            rect_feats_all[i, 8] = arr[:, 1].min()
            rect_feats_all[i, 9] = arr[:, 2].mean()
            rect_feats_all[i, 10] = arr[:, 2].std()
            rect_feats_all[i, 11] = arr[:, 2].max()
            rect_feats_all[i, 12] = arr[:, 2].min()
            rect_feats_all[i, 13] = len(rlist)
        # 14th element zero
    tab_feats = np.concatenate([hist_feats, seg_feats_all, rect_feats_all], axis=1)
    return tab_feats

                chain_val_probs[:, sp] = 0.5
                chain_test_probs[:, sp] = 0.5

            model.fit(current_train_feats, y_train)
            chain_val_probs[:, sp] = model.predict_proba(current_val_feats)[:, 1]
            chain_test_probs[:, sp] = model.predict_proba(current_test_feats)[:, 1]
            # Append predictions as new features for next species
            # For training: we need to add predictions for training set as well. Use OOF? Use training predictions from the same model? (risk of overfitting, but chain uses training predictions). We'll add train probability.
            train_preds = model.predict_proba(current_train_feats)[:, 1]
            # For validation and test, we use validation/test predictions
            # Augment features: concatenate
            current_train_feats = np.concatenate(
                [current_train_feats, train_preds.reshape(-1, 1)], axis=1
            )
            current_val_feats = np.concatenate(

            )
            current_test_feats = np.concatenate(

        val_preds_chain += chain_val_probs / n_chains

def create_mel_filterbank(sr, n_fft, n_mels, fmin, fmax):
    # Implementation following librosa / torchaudio
    # Convert fmin/fmax to mel scale
    def hz_to_mel(f):
        return 2595.0 * np.log10(1.0 + f / 700.0)

    def mel_to_hz(m):
        return 700.0 * (10.0 ** (m / 2595.0) - 1.0)

    low = hz_to_mel(fmin)
    high = hz_to_mel(fmax)
    mels = np.linspace(low, high, n_mels + 2)
    hz = mel_to_hz(mels)
    # Compute FFT bins
    fft_bins = np.fft.rfftfreq(n_fft, 1.0 / sr)
    # Create triangular filters
    fb = np.zeros((n_mels, fft_bins.shape[0]), dtype=np.float32)
    for i in range(n_mels):
        left = hz[i]
        center = hz[i + 1]
        right = hz[i + 2]
        for j, f in enumerate(fft_bins):
            if left < f <= center:
                fb[i, j] = (f - left) / (center - left)
            elif center < f < right:
                fb[i, j] = (right - f) / (right - center)
    # Normalize by triangular area
    fb *= 2.0 / (hz[2:] - hz[:-2])[:, None]
    return torch.from_numpy(fb)


def compute_mel_spectrogram(

):

    spec = torch.stft(
        waveform.squeeze(0),
        n_fft=n_fft,
        hop_length=hop_length,
        win_length=n_fft,
        window=window,
        center=True,
        return_complex=True,
    )  # (F, T)
    # Power spectrum
    power = spec.abs() ** 2  # (F, T)
    # Mel filterbank
    fb = create_mel_filterbank(sr, n_fft, n_mels, fmin, fmax).to(
        power.device
    )  # (n_mels, F)
    mel = torch.mm(fb, power)  # (n_mels, T)
    # Log

# Adapted from https://github.com/qiuqiangkong/audioset_tagging_cnn/
class ConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(
            out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        x = self.relu(self.bn2(self.conv2(x)))
        return x


class Cnn14(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, pretrained=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_block1 = ConvBlock(1, 64)
        self.conv_block2 = ConvBlock(64, 128)
        self.conv_block3 = ConvBlock(128, 256)
        self.conv_block4 = ConvBlock(256, 512)
        self.conv_block5 = ConvBlock(512, 1024)
        self.conv_block6 = ConvBlock(1024, 2048)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(2048, 19)  # not used, we take the 2048-d embedding
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self._init_weights()
        if pretrained:
            self.load_pretrained()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Conv2d):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="relu")
            elif isinstance(m, nn.BatchNorm2d):
                nn.init.constant_(m.weight, 1)
                nn.init.constant_(m.bias, 0)
            elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_normal_(m.weight)

    def load_pretrained(self):
        # Load from official checkpoint (Cnn14_mAP=0.431.pth) from Zenodo
        # This checkpoint is for 16kHz sampling rate, 64 mel bands, 1000 time frames.
        url = "https://zenodo.org/record/3987831/files/Cnn14_mAP%3D0.431.pth?download=1"
        try:
            state = torch.hub.load_state_dict_from_url(
                url, map_location="cpu", check_hash=True
            )["model"]
            # Remove fc weights (classifier)

            # Load with strict=False

                file=sys.stderr,

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.conv_block1(x)
        x = F.avg_pool2d(x, kernel_size=(2, 2), stride=(2, 2))
        x = self.conv_block2(x)
        x = F.avg_pool2d(x, kernel_size=(2, 2), stride=(2, 2))
        x = self.conv_block3(x)
        x = F.avg_pool2d(x, kernel_size=(2, 2), stride=(2, 2))
        x = self.conv_block4(x)
        x = F.avg_pool2d(x, kernel_size=(2, 2), stride=(2, 2))
        x = self.conv_block5(x)
        x = F.avg_pool2d(x, kernel_size=(2, 2), stride=(2, 2))

            d_model,
            nhead,
            dim_feedforward=d_model * 4,
            dropout=dropout,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, seg, mask):
        x = self.input_proj(seg)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.transformer(x, src_key_padding_mask=mask)
        valid = (~mask).float().unsqueeze(-1)
        pooled = (x * valid).sum(dim=1) / (valid.sum(dim=1) + 1e-8)
        return pooled


class HistogramMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_out=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(100, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(64, d_out),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class MultiStreamClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, panns_finetune_layers=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.segment_encoder = SegmentTransformer(d_model=128)
        self.hist_encoder = HistogramMLP(d_out=64)
        # PANNs CNN14
        self.panns = Cnn14(pretrained=True)
        # Freeze early layers, finetune last few ConvBlocks
        blocks = [
            self.panns.conv_block1,
            self.panns.conv_block2,
            self.panns.conv_block3,
            self.panns.conv_block4,
            self.panns.conv_block5,
            self.panns.conv_block6,
        ]
        for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
            for param in block.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = i >= len(blocks) - panns_finetune_layers
        self.spec_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2048, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3))
        fusion_in = 128 + 64 + 256
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(fusion_in, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, n_species),
        )

    def forward(self, seg, mask, hist, spec):
        seg_emb = self.segment_encoder(seg, mask)
        hist_emb = self.hist_encoder(hist)
        spec_feat = self.panns(spec)
        spec_emb = self.spec_proj(spec_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([seg_emb, hist_emb, spec_emb], dim=1)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ---------- Dataset ----------
class BirdDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self,
        indices,
        spec_augment=False,
        spec_aug_prob=0.5,
        n_time_masks=2,
        n_freq_masks=2,
        time_width=10,
        freq_width=10,
    ):
        self.indices = indices
        self.spec_augment = spec_augment
        self.spec_aug_prob = spec_aug_prob
        self.n_time_masks = n_time_masks
        self.n_freq_masks = n_freq_masks
        self.time_width = time_width
        self.freq_width = freq_width

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.indices)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        i = self.indices[idx]
        seg = torch.from_numpy(seg_tensor[i])
        mask = torch.from_numpy(seg_mask[i].astype(bool))
        hist = torch.from_numpy(hist_tensor[i])
        spec = torch.from_numpy(mel_tensor[i])  # (1,64,1000)
        if self.spec_augment and np.random.rand() < self.spec_aug_prob:
            spec = self.apply_spec_augment(spec)
        label = torch.from_numpy(y_full[i])
        return seg, mask, hist, spec, label

    def apply_spec_augment(self, spec):
        # spec: (1, freq, time)
        freq = spec.size(1)
        time = spec.size(2)
        # Frequency masking
        for _ in range(self.n_freq_masks):
            f = np.random.randint(0, self.freq_width)
            f_start = np.random.randint(0, freq - f)
            spec[:, f_start : f_start + f, :] = 0.0
        # Time masking
        for _ in range(self.n_time_masks):
            t = np.random.randint(0, self.time_width)
            t_start = np.random.randint(0, time - t)
            spec[:, :, t_start : t_start + t] = 0.0
        return spec


def mixup_collate(batch, alpha=0.2):
    segs, masks, hists, specs, labels = zip(*batch)
    segs = torch.stack(segs, dim=0)
    masks = torch.stack(masks, dim=0)
    hists = torch.stack(hists, dim=0)
    specs = torch.stack(specs, dim=0)
    labels = torch.stack(labels, dim=0)
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
        idx = torch.randperm(len(segs))
        segs = lam * segs + (1 - lam) * segs[idx]
        hists = lam * hists + (1 - lam) * hists[idx]
        specs = lam * specs + (1 - lam) * specs[idx]
        labels = lam * labels + (1 - lam) * labels[idx]
    return segs, masks, hists, specs, labels


# ---------- Label smoothing BCE loss ----------
class LabelSmoothingBCEWithLogitsLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        smoothed = targets * (1 - self.smoothing) + (1 - targets) * (
            self.smoothing / (n_species - 1)
        )
        return F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, smoothed)


# ---------- Evaluation helper ----------
def validate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_labels = []
    all_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels in loader:
            seg = seg.to(device)
            mask = mask.to(device)
            hist = hist.to(device)
            spec = spec.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits = model(seg, mask, hist, spec)
            prob = torch.sigmoid(logits)
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
            all_probs.append(prob.cpu().numpy())
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)
    all_probs = np.concatenate(all_probs, axis=0)
    aucs = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        if all_labels[:, i].sum() > 0:
            aucs.append(roc_auc_score(all_labels[:, i], all_probs[:, i]))
    return np.mean(aucs) if aucs else 0.5, all_probs


# ---------- XGBoost classifier chain training (per fold) ----------
def train_xgb_per_species(X_train, y_train, X_val, y_val):
    models = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
            n_estimators=500,
            max_depth=4,
            learning_rate=0.1,
            subsample=0.8,
            colsample_bytree=0.8,
            random_state=42,
            use_label_encoder=False,
            eval_metric="logloss",
            verbosity=0,
        )
        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train[:, i],
            eval_set=[(X_val, y_val[:, i])],
            verbose=False,
        )
        models.append(model)
    return models


# ---------- Main: 5-fold CV ----------
print("Starting 5-fold cross-validation...", file=sys.stderr)

# Bins for stratification
train_labels = y_full[train_idx]
bins = np.digitize(train_labels.sum(axis=1), bins=[0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 10])
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

oof_deep_probs = np.zeros((len(train_idx), n_species))
oof_xgb_probs = np.zeros((len(train_idx), n_species))
test_deep_probs = np.zeros((len(test_idx), n_species))
test_xgb_probs = np.zeros((len(test_idx), n_species))

fold_deep_aucs = []
fold_xgb_aucs = []
fold_ensemble_aucs = []

for fold, (train_part, val_part) in enumerate(skf.split(train_idx, bins)):
    print(f"\n=== Fold {fold+1} ===", file=sys.stderr)
    train_sub_idx = train_idx[train_part]
    val_sub_idx = train_idx[val_part]

    # ---- Deep model training ----
    train_ds = BirdDataset(train_sub_idx, spec_augment=True)
    val_ds = BirdDataset(val_sub_idx, spec_augment=False)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=12, shuffle=True, collate_fn=mixup_collate
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=12, shuffle=False)

    model = MultiStreamClassifier(panns_finetune_layers=2).to(device)

    # Separate parameter groups
    panns_params = [
        p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "panns" in n and p.requires_grad
    ]
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if "panns" not in n]
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(
        [{"params": panns_params, "lr": 1e-5}, {"params": other_params, "lr": 1e-3}],
        weight_decay=1e-4,
    )
    scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=50)
    criterion = LabelSmoothingBCEWithLogitsLoss(smoothing=0.1)
    scaler = GradScaler()

    best_val_auc = 0.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 7
    no_improve = 0

        for seg, mask, hist, spec, labels in train_loader:
            seg = seg.to(device)
            mask = mask.to(device)
            hist = hist.to(device)
            spec = spec.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():

                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()

        # Validation
        val_auc, _ = validate(model, val_loader, device)
        if val_auc > best_val_auc:
            best_val_auc = val_auc
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1
        if no_improve >= patience:
            break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    # OOF predictions
    val_ds_eval = BirdDataset(val_sub_idx, spec_augment=False)
    val_loader_eval = DataLoader(val_ds_eval, batch_size=12, shuffle=False)
    val_auc_deep, val_probs_deep = validate(model, val_loader_eval, device)
    fold_deep_aucs.append(val_auc_deep)
    oof_deep_probs[np.isin(train_idx, val_sub_idx)] = val_probs_deep

    # Deep test predictions
    test_ds = BirdDataset(test_idx, spec_augment=False)

    models_xgb = train_xgb_per_species(X_train_tab, y_train_tab, X_val_tab, y_val_tab)
    # OOF predictions
    val_preds_xgb = np.zeros((len(val_sub_idx), n_species))
    for i, model in enumerate(models_xgb):
        val_preds_xgb[:, i] = model.predict_proba(X_val_tab)[:, 1]
    oof_xgb_probs[np.isin(train_idx, val_sub_idx)] = val_preds_xgb
    # Compute xgb OOF AUC
    aucs_xgb = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        if y_val_tab[:, i].sum() > 0:
            aucs_xgb.append(roc_auc_score(y_val_tab[:, i], val_preds_xgb[:, i]))
    val_auc_xgb = np.mean(aucs_xgb) if aucs_xgb else 0.5
    fold_xgb_aucs.append(val_auc_xgb)
    print(f"  XGBoost OOF macro-AUC: {val_auc_xgb:.4f}", file=sys.stderr)

    # XGBoost test predictions
    X_test_tab = tab_X[test_idx]
    test_preds_xgb = np.zeros((len(test_idx), n_species))
    for i, model in enumerate(models_xgb):
        test_preds_xgb[:, i] = model.predict_proba(X_test_tab)[:, 1]
    test_xgb_probs += test_preds_xgb / 5.0

    # Simple ensemble on OOF
    ensemble_val = (val_probs_deep + val_preds_xgb) / 2.0
    aucs_ens = []
    for i in range(n_species):
        if y_val_tab[:, i].sum() > 0:
            aucs_ens.append(roc_auc_score(y_val_tab[:, i], ensemble_val[:, i]))
    val_auc_ens = np.mean(aucs_ens) if aucs_ens else 0.5
    fold_ensemble_aucs.append(val_auc_ens)
    print(f"  Ensemble OOF macro-AUC: {val_auc_ens:.4f}", file=sys.stderr)

print("\n=== Cross-validation results ===", file=sys.stderr)
print(
    f"Deep:      mean={np.mean(fold_deep_aucs):.4f}, std={np.std(fold_deep_aucs):.4f}",
    file=sys.stderr,
)
print(
    f"XGBoost:   mean={np.mean(fold_xgb_aucs):.4f}, std={np.std(fold_xgb_aucs):.4f}",
    file=sys.stderr,
)
print(
    f"Ensemble:  mean={np.mean(fold_ensemble_aucs):.4f}, std={np.std(fold_ensemble_aucs):.4f}",
    file=sys.stderr,
)

# Final test ensemble
final_test_probs = (test_deep_probs + test_xgb_probs) / 2.0

# ---------- Submission ----------
sub_rows = []
for idx_in_test, rid in enumerate(test_ids):
    for sp in range(n_species):
        sub_id = rid * 100 + sp
        prob = float(final_test_probs[idx_in_test, sp])
        sub_rows.append({"Id": sub_id, "Probability": prob})
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(sub_rows)
sub_df.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
print("submission.csv saved successfully.", file=sys.stderr)

class SpecAugment:
